Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 훈련에 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 자신의 몸 상태를 걸고 내기를 제안해 왔다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After failing the training, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> is waging her own stamina for a rematch.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トレーニングに失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>が自身の体調を賭けて勝負を挑んできた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 训练失败的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>以自己的身体状态为赌注提出打赌。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 訓練失敗的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>以自己的身體狀態為賭注提出打賭。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué à l'entraînement, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a parié sur sa propre endurance pour une revanche.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach dem gescheiterten Training schlug <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vor, ihre eigene Ausdauer als Einsatz für eine Revanche anzubieten.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de fallar el entrenamiento, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> apostó su propia resistencia para una revancha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar no treino, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> apostou sua própria resistência em uma revanche.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากล้มเหลวในการฝึก <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็เสนอการประลองอีกครั้งโดยเอาสภาพร่างกายของตนเองเป็นเดิมพันค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam latihan, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mempertaruhkan staminanya untuk pertandingan ulang.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại trong buổi huấn luyện, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thách đấu lại, cược vào thể lực của mình.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: प्रशिक्षण में विफल रहने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अपनी सहनशक्ति को दांव पर लगाकर दोबारा मैच की पेशकश की।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: You're hurt. Let's call it for today.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 怪我をした、今日は休もう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Ich bin verletzt, heute nur ein Kratzer.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ได้เลย วันนี้แค่เริ่มต้น
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Ya, hari ini kita istirahat saja.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đã xong, hôm nay chỉ vậy thôi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: तुम घायल हो। आज के लिए बस इतना ही।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: You're fine. Back to training it is.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 怪我はしていない、トレーニング再開だ。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Je n'ai pas été blessé, reprends les entraînements.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No me he caído, reanudo los entrenamientos.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่เสียหาย ฝึกฝนใหม่
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không bị thương, tôi sẽ tự huấn luyện lại.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: तुम ठीक हो। वापस प्रशिक्षण पर चलते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションがあるから飲んでおけ。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tiens, prends cette Potion de Vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Aqui, pegue esta Poção de Vitalidade.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มีโพชั่นพลังงานอยู่ กินซะสิคะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Có Thuốc Hồi Sức đây, uống đi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: यह लो, यह वाइटैलिटी पोशन ले लो।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió dejar el entrenamiento y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อนค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk mengakhiri latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng huấn luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschlossen hatte, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún parecía insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อน แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจเท่าไหร่ค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, फिर भी <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y logró resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e alcançou resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> กลับมาฝึกฝนอีกครั้งและประสบความสำเร็จ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> kembali menantang latihan dan meraih hasil.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử thách lại quá trình huấn luyện và đạt được thành quả.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber wieder.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero falló una vez más.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองฝึกอีกครั้งแต่ก็ล้มเหลวอีกครั้งค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại nhưng lại thất bại một lần nữa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर विफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est illuminée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou após receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับโพชั่นค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गई।
